verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a SaaS incident-management platform, but the evidence pack never mentions a FireHydrant SDK in any language. What it does show is a REST API with API keys, the fhcli command-line tool for recording change events, an OpenAPI document published inside the MCP repo, and an official MCP server. These are adjacent building blocks or belong to other stories, so none of them counts as official SDK support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
